notes.title: Card edges
notes.text: Outlined cards were hard to see where their edge was pale. Their edge is now a clearer grey, and in a section on Primary, Secondary or Tertiary the outlines of cards and fields are stronger. Filled and elevated cards are unchanged.
Carousels and bottom sheets can be scrolled with the keyboard, and the time picker numbers are easier to read
Check list boxes and Image grid links get names for screen readers, and keys in text are readable in dark mode
Lists and cards typed in place work better with a screen reader and the keyboard: a folding row has its own button, a card’s media has its own button, and the fields are tall enough to tap
Screen readers and voice control name block cards, notices, choice fields and subpage buttons by the text you see on them
Screen readers name the text area of a page and no longer reach into block previews
You can zoom the editor on a phone with a pinch or a double tap, and the Save bar and the text toolbar stay in view
